quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with sirens and flashing lights approaches you, should you pull to the right and let it pass?
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle using lights and/or sirens, pull to the right side of the road immediately and let it pass.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. Slow down on wet roads because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: If your vehicle has a two-part safety belt system, what should you do?

options.text: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.
questions.explanation: Always wear both the lap belt and shoulder belt. Using only one part reduces your protection. Even if you have an automatic shoulder belt, buckle your lap belt too.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: When your tire blows out, should you brake quickly and pull off the road?
questions.explanation: If you have a tire blowout, release the gas pedal, hold the steering wheel firmly, pull safely off the road, and check the tire. Do not brake suddenly.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: This round sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What is the only way to remove alcohol from your body?
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. Eating, drinking coffee, or taking a shower will not help.

questions.question: If a driver refuses to take a chemical test, will driving privileges be suspended for only three months?
questions.explanation: If you refuse a chemical test, your driving privileges will be suspended for one year. If you are under 21, the suspension is 6 months.

questions.question: When stopping on snow or ice with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), what should you do?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal firmly.
Stay off the brakes and wait for the car to drift to a stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal firmly.
questions.explanation: With ABS, press the brake pedal firmly on snow or ice. The ABS will pump the brakes faster than you can.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information and distances to locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: A teen driver can have two passengers under age 20 in the vehicle during the first 12 months of licensing.
questions.explanation: During the first 12 months, a teen driver (ages 16-17) can have only one passenger under age 20. Siblings, stepchildren, and biological children are exceptions to this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: You cannot pass a school bus when its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has flashing red lights, you must stop before reaching it and stay stopped until the lights turn off. On a divided highway, cars on the opposite side do not have to stop.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles at any time.

questions.question: Water on the road can cause hydroplaning. At what speed can this happen?
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning can start at speeds as low as 35 mph when water is on the road. Above 35 mph, tires cannot move water away fast enough and may lose contact with the road.

questions.question: What do orange background signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: It is safe to use cruise control on snowy or icy roads if you reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snowy or icy roads. Your tires may slip and you will lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a fork in the road ahead. Drivers must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: When daylight starts to fade, what should you use to help others see you?
questions.explanation: Turn on your low beams when daylight starts to fade. This helps others see you. Only use high beams in open areas with no other drivers nearby.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from top to bottom as red, yellow, green. This sign warns drivers that a traffic signal is ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: Can you turn left at a red light from a one-way street onto another one-way street moving left, after stopping and yielding?
questions.explanation: You can turn left at a red light when turning from a one-way street onto another one-way street with traffic moving left. You must stop completely and yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians first.

questions.question: Must you always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road?
questions.explanation: You must always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road, no matter which direction you are traveling. Be careful around children.

questions.question: How do you yield to an emergency vehicle using its siren and flashing lights?

options.text: Move to the right edge of the road and stop.
Move into the right lane and drive slowly until it passes.
Stop immediately, even if you are in an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right edge of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: Yield to any emergency vehicle using its siren and flashing lights. Drive to the right edge of the road and stop. Do not stop in an intersection. You can move again after the vehicle passes.

questions.question: What does a stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop, then proceed when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: When is it okay to drive on the shoulder to pass a car?

options.text: If the vehicle ahead is turning left.
If the shoulder is wide enough.

questions.explanation: Never pass on the shoulder. The other driver will not expect you there and may pull onto the shoulder. Passing on the right is only allowed if you can do it without leaving the road.

questions.question: What must you do at a "Yield" sign?

options.text: Yield the right-of-way to cross traffic that could cause conflict.
Yield the right-of-way only to vehicles on your right.
Always slow down and proceed without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield the right-of-way to cross traffic that could cause conflict.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down or stop if needed. Give the right-of-way to any crossing or merging traffic that is close enough to cause a problem.

questions.question: What driving skills are affected by alcohol and drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs hurt many driving skills. They slow reaction time, reduce coordination, reduce alertness, and make it hard to concentrate.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Turn on your high beam headlights.
Slow down and use your low beam headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Slow down and use low beams in fog. If the fog is too thick to see, pull off the road and wait for it to clear.

questions.question: Is it permitted to drive while taking medication that impairs your driving?

options.text: Yes, if you don't feel drowsy.
Yes, if a doctor prescribed it.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive while under the influence of anything that impairs your driving. This includes alcohol, prescription drugs, over-the-counter drugs, and illegal drugs.

questions.question: After dark, taillights do not need to be turned on.
questions.explanation: You must turn on your headlights from sunset to sunrise. Your vehicle must have two red taillights visible from 500 feet behind. Motorcycles and mopeds only need one taillight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Accessible parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming up.
